Query:
WITH target_tables AS (
    SELECT c.oid, c.relname
    FROM pg_class AS c
    JOIN pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
      AND c.relname IN ('ListingCommercialDetails', 'ListingLandDetails')
)
SELECT json_build_object(
    'captured_at_utc', to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
    'database', current_database(),
    'server_version', current_setting('server_version'),
    'tables', (
        SELECT json_agg(
            json_build_object(
                'table', t.relname,
                'heap_bytes', pg_relation_size(t.oid),
                'total_bytes', pg_total_relation_size(t.oid),
                'indexes', COALESCE((
                    SELECT json_agg(
                        json_build_object(
                            'name', i.relname,
                            'definition', pg_get_indexdef(i.oid),
                            'access_method', am.amname,
                            'key_columns', ARRAY(
                                SELECT pg_get_indexdef(i.oid, key_position, true)
                                FROM generate_series(1, ix.indnkeyatts) AS key_position
                                ORDER BY key_position
                            ),
                            'predicate', pg_get_expr(ix.indpred, ix.indrelid),
                            'is_valid', ix.indisvalid,
                            'is_ready', ix.indisready,
                            'is_live', ix.indislive,
                            'size_bytes', pg_relation_size(i.oid)
                        ) ORDER BY i.relname COLLATE "C"
                    )
                    FROM pg_index AS ix
                    JOIN pg_class AS i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid
                    JOIN pg_am AS am ON am.oid = i.relam
                    WHERE ix.indrelid = t.oid
                ), '[]'::json)
            ) ORDER BY t.relname COLLATE "C"
        )
        FROM target_tables AS t
    )
);

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "PK_ListingCommercialDetails" ON public."ListingCommercialDetails" USING btree ("ListingId")
